data.name: 2,2,5-Trimethylhexane with Water
measurement_methods: The solubility of (1) in (2) was determined by gas chromatography.
The solubility of (2) in (1) was determined by Karl Fischer titration.
mixing_methods: 50 mL of (1) together with 50 mL of (2) were placed were placed in a 125 mL Hypovial closed with a Teflon coated rubber septum and placed in a constant-temperature water bath.
The system was stirred magnetically for 24 hr or was kept in the bath without stirring for at least 7 days before samples were taken for analysis.

publication_references.citation: Polak, J.; Lu, B.C.Y., Can. J. Chem. 1973, 51, 4018-23.
